details.description:
7 times stronger than steel, CHANEL ceramic weathers all storms. Yet its greatest strength lies in its softness: polished with diamond powder, it feels as smooth as silk against the skin. An exceptional material that embodies all the expertise and cutting-edge technology of the CHANEL Watch Manufacture.

The silhouette of the J12 watch sets itself apart with its clean, precise lines. Yet, once worn, it is its softness that stands out. Cabochon, middle case, links: every contact point is meticulously crafted to soften the angles, making them imperceptible to the touch. This sensory appeal, meticulously perfected for over a quarter of a century, reveals the watchmaking excellence of CHANEL with understated strength.

details.description:
Making the invisible visible. It was with this vision in mind that the Calibre 12.1 self-winding Manufacture movement was designed in 2019. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, it features diamond-polished bevels and an openwork oscillating weight in tungsten: a dense, heavy material perfectly suited to winding the barrel spring and guaranteeing a 70-hour power reserve, far superior to traditional standards. Power delivered smoothly, to guarantee performance and precision. Visible through a sapphire crystal caseback, the oscillating weight forms a perfect circle: the watchmaking signature of the House.

7 times stronger than steel, CHANEL ceramic weathers all storms. Yet its greatest strength lies in its softness: polished with diamond powder, it feels as smooth as silk against the skin. An exceptional material that embodies all the expertise and cutting-edge technology of the CHANEL Watch Manufacture.

The silhouette of the J12 watch sets itself apart with its clean, precise lines. Yet, once worn, it is its softness that stands out. Cabochon, middle case, links: every contact point is meticulously crafted to soften the angles, making them imperceptible to the touch. This sensory appeal, meticulously perfected for over a quarter of a century, reveals the watchmaking excellence of CHANEL with understated strength.
